about_the_game:
Dreamers, your support fuels the journey! The RailGods of Hysterra Supporter Pack is for those who believe in our vision and want to help us expand the game during Early Access. By purchasing this pack, you directly support the developers, allowing us to bring even more content, features, and horrors to life.

As a token of our gratitude, you will receive:

— Digital Artbook: Explore the creative process behind RailGods of Hysterra.

— HD Wallpapers: Stunning artwork to immerse yourself in the eerie beauty of Hysterra.

— Full Soundtrack: Enjoy the haunting melodies and atmospheric music that bring the world to life.

— Digital card with sincere gratitude and signatures of the developer's team

— Printable Thematic Poster: A unique piece of artwork to showcase your love for the game.

— Social Media Pack: A set of exclusive emojis and avatars to display your support.

— In-Game Cosmetics: Equip your Dreamer with a set of exclusive items to stand out in the madness of Hysterra: Explorer’s Backpack, Crow Skull Mask, Ritual Mask, Shaman’s Outfit, Lost Axe of Yig.

Your contribution helps us refine and expand RailGods of Hysterra throughout Early Access, ensuring we deliver the best possible experience. Thank you for being part of this journey, your support keeps the Eternal Railway running!

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: violence, blood, use of drugs and alcohol.

  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050Ti/AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
